cases.expected: Resolve exact Russian designation, status, order and effective date before routing a standard.
Preserve the source ISO edition printed in the national adoption record.
A newer ISO edition or amendment does not automatically amend the Russian GOST.
National and international lifecycle statuses must be evaluated independently on the evidence date.
An active GOST is not automatically mandatory without a separate legal, contractual or conformity-assessment basis.
27006 requirements address certification bodies and do not replace the organization requirements in 27001.
27019 is sector guidance for non-nuclear energy utilities and does not replace energy-sector legislation.
27021 competence requirements do not themselves issue a personnel qualification, licence or certification.
The 2021 international amendment to 27021 remains outside the Russian adoption unless national adoption evidence is produced.
27031 guidance does not supply universal or legally fixed RTO, RPO or recovery values.
27033-4 gateway guidance does not mandate a product, certification class or firewall architecture by itself.
27033-5 VPN guidance does not create a universal cryptography or SKZI applicability trigger.
A national/international conformity claim must identify designation, edition, amendment state and scope.
Mixed-edition use requires an explicit delta record rather than assumed equivalence.
Catalogue metadata proves lifecycle metadata, not immutable normative body bytes.
Where the exact edition, amendment or applicability basis is missing, route to PENDING and fail closed.
Do not import newer clause numbering, terminology or controls into an older national adoption.
Do not invent transition periods, control crosswalks, audit durations, recovery metrics or cryptographic requirements.
